analysis.insight_summary: Participants discuss the connection limits between [product_name] modules and a PC using [product_name] for visualization. There is some uncertainty about the exact maximum number of supported connections and a clear need for better documentation, especially for new users. Suggestions include gathering data in fewer [product_name] modules to work around the connection restrictions, highlighting the demand for scalable integration solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek straightforward ways to connect multiple [product_name] modules (at least 8–10) to one PC for central visualization, and expect detailed guidance or documentation about system connection limits.
